features.feature_summary: Users can import large vector datasets and add KML, KMZ, and GeoJSON files as data layers from a mobile device.
features.extended_definition: Users can import large vector datasets and add KML, KMZ, and GeoJSON files as data layers from a mobile device.

features.feature_summary: Users can perform site suitability analysis with elevation contours as granular as 1 meter.
features.extended_definition: Users can perform site suitability analysis with elevation contours as granular as 1 meter.

features.feature_summary: Users can request access to Google Earth projects they do not currently have permission to view.
features.extended_definition: Users can request access to Google Earth projects they do not currently have permission to view.

features.feature_summary: Users can search satellite and aerial basemap imagery with a multimodal model to find visual patterns and localize them on the map.
features.extended_definition: Users can search satellite and aerial basemap imagery with a multimodal model to find visual patterns and localize them on the map.

features.feature_summary: Users can import their own large-scale KML and GeoJSON datasets into Google Earth projects as data layers.
features.extended_definition: Users can import their own large-scale KML and GeoJSON datasets into Google Earth projects as data layers.

features.feature_summary: Users can copy a style from one point, line, or polygon and paste it onto another feature of the same type.
features.extended_definition: Users can copy a style from one point, line, or polygon and paste it onto another feature of the same type.

features.feature_summary: Google Earth can automatically reuse the most recent style for newly created points, lines, and polygons of the same type.
features.extended_definition: Google Earth can automatically reuse the most recent style for newly created points, lines, and polygons of the same type.

features.feature_summary: Data layers now support uniform, categorical, and numerical styling options in the inspector panel.
features.extended_definition: Data layers now support uniform, categorical, and numerical styling options in the inspector panel.

features.feature_summary: Users can view vector data layers as tabular data, inspect features in the table, and identify them on the map.
features.extended_definition: Users can view vector data layers as tabular data, inspect features in the table, and identify them on the map.

features.feature_summary: Users can select and modify multiple placemarks, lines, and polygons at the same time in the Map contents panel.
features.extended_definition: Users can select and modify multiple placemarks, lines, and polygons at the same time in the Map contents panel.

features.feature_summary: Users can discover and add professional-grade data layers to Google Earth projects.
features.extended_definition: Users can discover and add professional-grade data layers to Google Earth projects.

features.feature_summary: Users can create and analyze geospatial datasets by asking natural-language questions about spatial relationships and project context.
features.extended_definition: Users can create and analyze geospatial datasets by asking natural-language questions about spatial relationships and project context.

features.feature_summary: Ask Google Earth can use Street View-derived datasets to help users locate infrastructure assets in the US.
features.extended_definition: Ask Google Earth can use Street View-derived datasets to help users locate infrastructure assets in the US.
